scope: bounded document-review prepare replay; no pilot, service, network, or canonical-data mutation

diagnosis.cause: prepare always reopened the live detail page and required the pending URL to remain in the current official listing; a previously captured, hash-verified review case was not consulted first
diagnosis.risk: a disappeared official listing made an already preserved Retificação01 review irrecoverable, while an arbitrary URL must not become admissible

change.behavior: reuse only the current owner/run/revision/method prepared case when it has documents whose exact URL equals artifact requested/final URL, host is the bound candidate or selected artifact host, bytes exist, byte_len matches, and SHA-256 matches; otherwise continue normal live validation
change.foreign_url: not replayed; normal identity-bound path remains responsible for rejection
change.idempotence: repeated prepare returns the same preserved case without driver/download or new case

tests.result: PASS: 62 passed, 879 warnings, 113.13s (four directed review suites)
coverage: preserved case replays after live listing disappearance
same-host document URL differing from preserved artifact URL is not replayed
document outside current pending manifest is not replayed

existing document-review ownership/revision/approval gates remain green
